type K = keyof { 0: string; "1": number; 2.5: boolean; a: 1 };
const k0: K = 0;
const k1: K = "1";
const k2: K = 2.5;
const bad1: K = "0";
const bad2: K = 1;
interface I { 3: string; [4]: number }
const i3: keyof I = 3;
const i4: keyof I = 4;
const o = { 5: "x" };
const o5: keyof typeof o = 5;
class Cn { 6 = 1; }
const c6: keyof Cn = 6;
console.log(k0, k1, k2, i3, i4, o5, c6);
